name: The Stage & Prompt Corner
description: The set of The Glass Widow still stands under working lights. Stage left, the prompt corner: a desk, a cue-light panel and the prompt book.
arrival: Harriet Pell is at the prompt desk with a pencil behind her ear, checking the book as if the show might go up again tonight.

spots.label: Read the prompt book
spots.text: Every cue of last night, in Harriet's hand. Crane's exit is marked at 21:40. One page carries another hand: the assistant called four cues between 21:52 and 21:56.

spots.label: Check the props table
spots.text: Everything is taped out in its place except one outline: a candlestick. Whoever took it knew where to look.

name: Backstage Corridor & Stage Door
description: A narrow painted corridor from the stage door, past the dressing rooms, to the pass door that opens into the auditorium.
arrival: The stage-door keeper's cubby, a payphone on the wall, and at the far end, the pass door to the front of house.

spots.label: Read the stage-door keeper's log
spots.text: Every company member in and out. One entry during the second act: F. Marsh, out 21:50, in 22:10.

spots.label: Look at the tray outside Dressing Room 1
spots.text: A tea tray on the floor by Crane's door, the tea long cold. Wardrobe's tag on the handle: 'Mr Crane, 22:00'.

spots.label: Try the pass door
spots.text: Locked, and heavy. From this side you'd need the key too. Nothing to learn by rattling it.

name: Dressing Room 1
description: Crane's dressing room: a lit mirror, a chaise, a writing desk, and the chalk outline on the carpet.
arrival: The mirror bulbs are still on. Someone has put a sheet over the chaise. The room smells faintly of greasepaint and something sweeter.

spots.label: Look at the body and the room
spots.text: Crane found on the floor of Dressing Room 1 by the stage manager.

spots.label: Look behind the radiator
spots.text: Wedged behind the radiator: the brass candlestick, its gilt still tacky from a retouch, a partial print pressed into it.

spots.label: Check the ashtray
spots.text: Crane never smoked. There's a cigar band in his ashtray anyway.

spots.label: Go through the writing desk
spots.text: Under the first-night telegrams, a letter on Hollywood letterhead. It has been read more than once.

spots.label: Read the cards around the mirror
spots.text: Good-luck cards from half of Ridgeway. Nothing from his agent, which is odd for an agent.

name: The Green Room
description: Sagging armchairs, a kettle, a tray of untouched sandwiches from last night's party that never happened.
arrival: Cordelia Vane holds court from the best armchair. Felix Marsh stands when you come in, then doesn't know what to do with his hands.

spots.label: Look through Felix's bag
spots.text: A script, a comb, and a letter from a touring company offering him the lead 'should the role become available'.

spots.label: Read the call board
spots.text: Rehearsal notes and the running order. It tells you who was on when, and nothing more.

name: Front of House & Box B
description: Red velvet, gilt, and the house manager's office behind the bar. Box B hangs over the stage on the left.
arrival: Leonard Voight is in the manager's office with a cigar he hasn't lit, being very kind to everyone.

spots.label: Ask the house manager for the boxes' latecomers' book
spots.text: The usher's neat hand: 'Box B door open 21:45 — gentleman stepped out. Closed 22:05.'

spots.label: Check the front-of-house key board
spots.text: The pass-door key's sign-out card: out 21:44, back 22:04, initialled 'L.V.'

spots.label: Go through the manager's files
spots.text: Box-office returns and a copy of Crane's contract. And an insurance schedule naming Voight Management.

spots.label: Talk to the barman
spots.text: He sold a lot of gin in the interval and noticed nothing after it. Twenty minutes you won't get back.

name: Wardrobe
description: Racks of costumes, two sewing machines, and a sign-in sheet on a clipboard by the door.
arrival: Mae Donnelly is sewing a button that doesn't need sewing. She doesn't look up until you say her name.

spots.label: Read the wardrobe sign-in sheet
spots.text: Costumes out and in, with times. 20:50: Miss Vane collects her Act 2 gown from Dressing Room 1 — '(raised voices)' in the margin.
